facts.subject: the current compiler (ASCII -> typed IR -> capability IR -> H_G -> planner -> verifier -> codegen -> BundleVerifier), the generated runtime, the browser harness and factc observe at the D24 tree
facts.predicate: four semantically distinct specimens execute through the same machinery with no specimen-specific branch: Byte Relay (one relation, two backends, minimize), ledger-mirror (system ledger_mirror, three components, two relations post/mirror of type Entry, payloads of 1, 0 and 1000 bytes, single backend, no objective, FEASIBLE), pixel-vault (system pixel_vault, relation stash of type Tile, GPU-only registry, payloads of 3 and 17 bytes; without WebGPU no plan activates and nothing is invented) and dual-stream (system dual_stream, relations feed/drain of type Chunk, two backends, MAXIMIZE preference_rank ranking CPU_WASM64 first, four variants); each bundle's strategy data lists every transfer with a per-variant requirement, every transfer of every payload emerges exact in Chromium with and without WebGPU, controlled loss of the specimen's backend reselects (dual-stream: CPU_WASM64 -> the all-WEBGPU variant) or leaves E1 without a plan (ledger-mirror, pixel-vault), observe binds each tape to its bundle, post-build integrity holds and no bundle carries another specimen's names or bytes
facts.note: I-09 and I-20 closed by execution: the single-relation runtime was a real defect (reproduced on the base compiler: the two-relation specimen's strategy named one relation), repaired by per-transfer strategy data and transfer(relation, bytes); the adapter library stays backend-specific machinery keyed by registry recipe names; the semantics the language currently claims (a typed data transfer between ports) is the whole generic surface - no second operation kind is claimed

facts.subject: an evidence tape of a generated bundle against the bundle's metadata
facts.predicate: the generated runtime opens every tape with a bundle record naming the sha256 of the verified strategy data it executes under (STRATEGY_SHA256 in selector.js, strategy_data_sha256 in bundle.json, both re-verified by the BundleVerifier: B-06-selector-strategy-identity, B-08-lineage-strategy-data); factc observe compares the record with the manifest it is given and rejects a tape of another bundle (diagnostic EVIDENCE_UNBOUND, evidence_lineage ERR, exit 1) while accepting the bundle's own tape (evidence_lineage OBS); the strategy data carries no source identity, so layout and label changes leave the executable files identical (P6-X03/X04 hold)
facts.note: I-30 repaired; the observe transport carries the third identity as flag bit 2 (wasm-abi) and the native driver parses it from the manifest; BUILD + OBSERVE in Chromium remain byte-identical to the native driver with the bound tape
required_environment: HOST_NATIVE_SET factc; Chromium for the transport comparison
